correctness.rationale: Verified the exact Hessian equation, exhaustive geometric singularity classification via the additive cubic, nondegenerate local quadratic forms at both node orbits, and exact F3/F9 point counts. K3 and Weil conclusions reconstructed: sum of squares of all 22 normalized roots equals 22, forcing every root to be ±1. The spectral multiplicities and zeta function follow; odd-characteristic Tate theorem gives Picard ranks. Embedded source and actual output supply finite certificates.
